user_feedback.attribution: Direct user message in project curation chat
user_feedback.quote: 我看到磁盘已经清理了，目前我看四个会话都已经完成了，且都输出了不差的视频内容。请你帮我解析与知识沉淀，推广知识等，目前解决了那么多问题，解决方式和知识应该是有的
user_feedback.interpretation: Positive overall feedback and authorization to curate and generalize procedures; no exact-version acceptance or waiver of documented defects.

observations.lesson: Scene-specific registered references and foreground layers improved the full visual preview; copied masks and continuous odd/even encoded checks prevented periodic leakage. Prior audio fidelity limitation remains.
Failure counterexample: pose and mirror mismatch, clipped icons and OCR-negative residual lettering. Native encoded frames override thumbnail/OCR impressions.
observations.boundary: Existing same-Agent records and selected images reviewed; no new complete audiovisual acceptance.

observations.lesson: Dynamic model donor restricted to the required region avoids a frozen-head plate. Retiming requires exact frame/PTS checks. German pilot is self-reviewed, hair/trails approximate and icons omitted.
observations.boundary: Existing same-Agent records and selected images reviewed; no new complete audiovisual acceptance.

observations.lesson: Two-second local video-donor composite improves erasure. Include colored halo in boundary and preserve semi-transparent icons geometrically; reconstructed fingers remain approximate and target animation is not yet validated.
observations.boundary: Existing same-Agent records and selected images reviewed; no new complete audiovisual acceptance.

generalization: Conditional route selection, layered masks/foreground/target typography, continuous encoded review, and bounded asset reuse; not a universal inpainting recipe.
not_promoted: Retimed model input as a default saving strategy
Omission of icons or approximate fingers as general acceptance
proof_boundary: Integrity verification of independent cases and packages, selected-frame visual inspection, existing attributed reviews; no new paid task or full-video test.
